blocks.html: Our newly-renovated treatment facility provides our clients with a secluded and safe space where recovery thrives. items: No Obligation When You Contact Us

blocks.text: Dallas Detox Center is unlike any other treatment center in the state of Texas. From the caring and compassionate staff to the luxury amenities, they have gone above and beyond to provide a world-class environment where people can really recover from the disease of addiction.
